products.name: Ergo 3.0x Loupe System
products.description: Entry-level ergonomic loupe with 3.0x magnification, ideal for general dentistry

data.primary: The Ergo 3.0x combines classic design with modern optical technology. A versatile magnification level suitable for most dental and surgical procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Soul, and Indie. Each frame comes in various colors to match your personal style. Features fixed declination angle optimized for standard working positions.

products.name: Ergo 4.0x Loupe System
products.description: Mid-range ergonomic loupe with 4.0x magnification for detailed procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 4.0x offers enhanced magnification for practitioners requiring greater detail visualization. Ideal for endodontics, restorative work, and surgical procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Soul, and Indie. The increased magnification provides excellent detail while maintaining a comfortable field of view.

products.name: Ergo 5.0x Loupe System
products.description: High-magnification ergonomic loupe for precision dental and surgical work

data.primary: The Ergo 5.0x delivers exceptional magnification for demanding procedures requiring superior detail. Perfect for microsurgery, complex endodontics, and precision restorations.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Jazz, and Soul. The 5.0x magnification provides outstanding visual clarity while the ergonomic design ensures comfort during extended procedures.

products.name: Ergo 6.0x Loupe System
products.description: Professional-grade 6.0x magnification for advanced clinical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 6.0x provides professional-grade magnification for specialists requiring exceptional detail visualization. Ideal for periodontal surgery, implantology, and complex restorative procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple premium frame styles. The advanced optics deliver crystal-clear images while maintaining a usable field of view and depth of field.

products.name: Ergo 7.5x Loupe System
products.description: High-performance 7.5x magnification for microsurgical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 7.5x delivers high-performance magnification approaching microscope levels while maintaining the freedom of movement that loupes provide.
data.secondary: Designed for specialists in endodontics, periodontal microsurgery, and other disciplines requiring exceptional visual detail. Available in premium frame styles.

products.name: Ergo 10x Loupe System
products.description: Maximum magnification loupe system for the most demanding microsurgical applications

data.primary: The Ergo 10x represents the pinnacle of loupe magnification technology. Provides microscope-level detail while maintaining the ergonomic benefits and freedom of movement that loupes offer.
data.secondary: Designed for the most demanding applications in endodontic microsurgery, periodontal surgery, and specialized dental procedures. Available in premium frame styles.

products.name: Ergo V Loupe System
products.description: Next-generation ergonomic design with adjustable declination for optimal posture

data.primary: The Ergo V features Admetec's revolutionary adjustable declination system, allowing you to customize the viewing angle from 0° to 45° for optimal ergonomic posture.
data.secondary: Available in multiple magnification levels. The Ergo V significantly reduces neck and back strain during extended procedures while maintaining exceptional optical clarity.

products.name: Ergo V Pro Loupe System
products.description: Premium version with integrated LED lighting and enhanced ergonomics

data.primary: The Ergo V Pro combines the revolutionary ergonomic design of the Ergo V with an integrated high-performance LED lighting system for complete visual enhancement.
data.secondary: Features adjustable declination, premium titanium frame, and wireless LED headlight delivering 55,000 lux. The complete solution for demanding clinical environments.

products.name: Galilean 2.5x Loupe
products.description: Lightweight Galilean loupes perfect for general dentistry and examinations

data.primary: The Galilean 2.5x offers an excellent entry point into magnification. The simple optical design provides a wide field of view and excellent depth of field.
data.secondary: Perfect for general examinations, hygiene procedures, and practitioners new to magnification. Ultra-lightweight design reduces neck strain. Available in multiple frame styles.

products.name: Galilean 2.7x Loupe
products.description: Popular mid-range Galilean loupe with excellent balance of magnification and comfort

data.primary: The Galilean 2.7x offers a step up in magnification while maintaining the lightweight comfort of Galilean optics. Ideal for practitioners seeking slightly more detail.
data.secondary: The most popular magnification choice among general practitioners. Provides excellent balance between magnification power and field of view.

products.name: Galilean 3.2x Loupe
products.description: Maximum magnification Galilean loupe for enhanced detail visualization

data.primary: The Galilean 3.2x provides the maximum magnification achievable with Galilean optics while maintaining their characteristic lightweight design.
data.secondary: Ideal for practitioners who need more magnification but prefer the wider field of view and lighter weight of Galilean technology over prismatic loupes.

products.name: Prismatic Loupe System
products.description: High-magnification prismatic loupes for precision work requiring exceptional detail

data.primary: Admetec Prismatic loupes deliver superior optical performance for demanding procedures. The prismatic optical system provides enhanced depth of field and edge-to-edge clarity.
data.secondary: Designed for specialists requiring the highest level of magnification and image quality. Available in multiple magnification levels from 4.0x to 6.0x.

products.name: Anya AY-3000 Dental Chair
products.description: Entry-level dental chair with essential features for modern dental practice

data.secondary: Features smooth hydraulic movement, comfortable patient positioning, and reliable construction. Compatible with a wide range of delivery systems and accessories.

products.name: Anya AY-6000 Dental Chair
products.description: Mid-range dental chair with advanced features and enhanced ergonomics

data.primary: The Anya AY-6000 represents excellent value in the mid-range segment, offering advanced features typically found in premium chairs at a competitive price point.
data.secondary: Features programmable positions, integrated LED lighting, enhanced patient comfort with memory foam cushioning, and a comprehensive delivery system. Ideal for growing practices.

products.name: Anya AY-8000 Premium Dental Chair
products.description: Premium dental chair with top-tier features for discerning practitioners

data.primary: The Anya AY-8000 is the flagship dental chair offering uncompromising quality, advanced technology, and exceptional patient comfort for premium dental practices.
data.secondary: Features include touchscreen controls, integrated multimedia system, synchronized movements, premium leather upholstery with heating option, and advanced infection control features.

products.name: Surgical Implant Motor
products.description: Precision implant motor with advanced torque control for surgical procedures

data.primary: A precision surgical implant motor designed for dental implant placement and bone surgery. Features advanced torque control and programmable speed settings.
data.secondary: LED display shows real-time torque, speed, and irrigation status. Compatible with all major implant systems. Includes foot pedal control and comprehensive accessory kit.

products.name: PTX Piezo Surgery Unit
products.description: Advanced piezoelectric surgery unit for precise bone cutting

data.primary: The PTX Piezo Surgery Unit delivers precise, controlled bone cutting using ultrasonic vibration technology. Minimizes soft tissue damage while providing excellent visibility.
data.secondary: Ideal for implant site preparation, sinus lifts, bone grafting, and periodontal surgery. Features automatic frequency tuning and multiple power presets.

products.name: Automatic Handpiece Lubricator
products.description: Automated lubrication system for dental handpieces

data.primary: The Automatic Handpiece Lubricator ensures consistent, thorough lubrication of dental handpieces with the press of a button. Extends handpiece life and maintains performance.
data.secondary: Compatible with high-speed and low-speed handpieces. Programmable lubrication cycles ensure optimal oil distribution every time.
